title: Stats
intro: The numbers people ask for during the event: bandwidth now and at its peak, uplinks, online seats and the busiest ports. Read from the switches every couple of minutes.
resetConfirm: Start the event's peak again from now? Do this after load tests, before doors open.
collecting: Collecting: the first numbers show after the next read of the switches.
noMonitoring: Needs a monitoring source (LibreNMS) to read the switches.
onlineRange: Seats online in this time: {{lo}} to {{hi}}
noUplinks: No uplinks found: name them in the port description ("Uplink to dist-01").
